description:
One drunken night, I thought I finally slept with Ko Woon-Ha, the person I’ve quietly loved for years. At least… that’s what I believed.

 *“Was it really you? Please tell me it wasn’t…”

“If not me, then who were you expecting?”*

Turns out, it wasn’t Woon-Ha at all! It was his younger brother, Ko-San. Ko-San, the walking disaster. The charming troublemaker. The human hurricane who makes me want to strangle him every time he smirks. The more I try to escape his orbit, the more tangled up I get... like he’s pulling me into his chaos without even trying. Was that night really just an accident? Or is Ko-San deliberately keeping me within arm’s reach? One thing’s for sure. Whatever this is, it’s not going to be simple…and I can’t even look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)
